All operations are confined to the build directory and package destination.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, data exfiltration, or execution of external scripts. The maintainer follows secure practices such as validating desktop and AppStream metadata. While the source uses a version tag instead of a Git commit hash (which reduces reproducibility slightly), this is common for tagged releases and not inherently unsafe. Overall, the PKGBUILD adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no evidence of malicious behavior.
